frozen_policy.baseline: same-date lowest-RSI top1 in the identical complete-case cohort

known_at_contract.flow: Earliest fetched_at for a flow_date/ticker must be no later than the next-session entry date; rows first fetched later fail closed.
known_at_contract.options: Forward EOD snapshots are usable no earlier than stored options_usable_trade_date; OI is treated as next-session state because same-day clearing direction is unavailable.
known_at_contract.price: Signal-day OHLCV only; no future bar enters cohort formation or ranking.

source_contract.onclickmedia_authorization_basis: Provider describes an open, no-key research API but limits data to educational/research use and disclaims real-time trading or financial-decision use.
source_contract.onclickmedia_lineage_caveat: Aggregator uses public sources; vendor_asof and original licensed-feed lineage are unavailable.

transmission_mapping.mechanism: Deep drawdown plus stronger large-order net buying and concentrated near-price put inventory may identify short-lived absorption and hedging-rebalance states.
transmission_mapping.forbidden_interpretation: put support, bullish dealer gamma, or institution-confirmed accumulation

replacement_value_comparator.primary: same-date lowest-RSI top1 in identical cohort

live_realistic_execution_envelope.order_semantics: research next-open fill model; no live order
live_realistic_execution_envelope.incremental_notional: min(USD 4000, 10% NAV minus existing ticker market value)
live_realistic_execution_envelope.liquidity_and_slippage: 35bp round trip is the fixed research assumption; next-open gap tail risk remains a falsifier.
kill_switches: stale or missing flow/options snapshot fails closed
existing ticker or portfolio cap breach fails closed

why_not_repairable_this_run: Eleven additional H10-settled disagreement decisions require new calendar observations and settlement; they cannot be backfilled as forward PIT evidence.

The three canonical windows predate the forward option-chain face, so five executable touches per window require a separately authorized, auditable historical PIT chain rather than relabeling present archives.
The provider's research-only disclaimer cannot be converted into live-trading authorization by a local schema edit.
Changing expiries, strike coverage, thresholds, cost, horizon, top-N, or response would retune the frozen lane rather than satisfy its reopen contract.

reopen_condition.primary: Keep the formula unchanged and reach at least 20 H10-settled PIT-safe paired disagreement decisions; current 9, so at least 11 additional are required.
reopen_condition.canonical_alternative: Obtain an authorized, untruncated historical PIT option chain with at least three expiries plus decision-time flow vintages, then demonstrate at least five executable treatment touches in each canonical window.
additional_bars: source contract pass for the claimed use
maximum ticker selection share at most 40 percent
full-chain coverage audit for expiry and strike truncation
position-control pass before any future live consideration
reopen_condition.earliest_check_event: A new fixed-formula disagreement reaches its tenth subsequent regular-session close and the total H10-settled disagreement count advances above 9.
